lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 distinct vertical white line segments; spacing is relatively consistent across the mid-section but compresses slightly at the posterior transition.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line and the two most posterior lines are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7-8 distinct white spots is visible on the upper hind limb/haunch, showing higher density in the mid-thigh region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A sequence of three spots on the central haunch aligns horizontally to form a semi-linear geometric pattern.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a lyrate trajectory, projecting posterodorsally from the skull before curving inward toward the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the horn tips is approximately 2.8 times the width of the visible horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tips comprise approximately 15% of the total vertical horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright tan-orange coloration on the lower limbs creating a 'sock' effect, and a visible high-contrast white patch on the lower throat region.
